source.assembly: 1 root, 16 top-level instances (NAUO1..16; NAUO1 holds 2 solids), 315 leaf solid instances, 65 distinct solids; no sub-assembly nesting beyond one level for the arms (150 parts each)
source.load: STEPCAFControl/XCAF: read 4 s, transfer 43 s, full tree walk + bbox/volume/BREP dump ~7 min at nice 19, single process; RAM never an issue (<10 GB machine-wide)

axes.up: +Y (inferred: arms are in the upright ReBeL pose, ZLW is a 1250 mm lift, column is triangular with a flat foot at y=-1351)
axes.forward: +Z (arms stand in front of the lift face z=739; column foot extends rearwards to z=278)
axes.lateral: X; with forward=+Z and up=+Y, robot-left = +X, so arm A (x=-424) is the LEFT arm and arm B (x=-884) the right arm. NOT confirmed by the customer.
axes.deck_plane: y=-1351 (lowest face of column and wings). The CAD contains no AMR, no floor plate; height above deck h = y + 1351 mm

column_gusset.note: 100 mm thick triangular plate, 1151 tall, depth 405 at the foot tapering to 95 at the top, 3 lightening cut-outs; front face z=675 carries the ZLW (20 x M6.8 holes). Foot face y=-1351 has 4 x d6.8 (counterbore d12) holes on a 50 x 100 mm pattern (x=-677/-627, z=466/566): presumed AMR interface

side_wings.note: two 149 x 600 x 70 mm triangular rib plates on the column front face, bottom at the deck plane

zlw_lift.drawn_pose: carriage is at mid-stroke (body centre y=-460.5 = carriage centre)
zlw_lift.assumption: stroke 1250 mm taken from the product name; end-block geometry (carriage y -1235..315 at the ends) agrees

rail_bracket.note: 8 mm plate bracket: vertical floor plate on the carriage (z 739-747, 5 holes), shelf at y=-283 carrying the X rail (10 holes), two triangular side gussets with an open pocket between them (inner width 194 mm)

x_rail.name: WS-16-120-660
x_rail.carriages: 2 x WW-16-120-20 (200 long) + WHKD-1620 clamps; A at the +X end, B at the -X end; each can slide inwards 260 mm (combined free length 660-2x200)

structure.upper_plates: 2 x 250x200x5 mm plates at y=-246.7..-241.7 on the carriages = arm base mounting
structure.carrier_plates: 2 x 325x300x3 mm plates at y=-241.7..-238.7 at x=-323..2 and -1310..-985: not attached to anything, treated as obstacles

arms.pose: upright (all joints near zero), J1 axis along Y, base flange bolted to the upper plate; 923 mm base-to-flange; centre spacing 460 mm; tube path along the arm assumed 960 mm
arms.note: no gripper/tool, no cabling, no controller in the CAD

search.voxel_note: conservative surface raster + cavity fill (volumes overestimate by 5-15 %); finalists re-checked against ~80k mesh sample points per group (4 mm spacing) over the full sweep

families.FIXED: rigid with column/wings, clears all moving parts
families.DECK: as FIXED but resting on an assumed deck at y=-1351
families.CARRIAGE: rigid with the ZLW carriage (moves in Y), clears the column over the stroke and the arms sliding in X
families.ARM_A: rigid with arm A's X carriage (moves in X and Y), clears everything else

search.tube_model: tube_total = max L1 distance(box centre -> arm base centre over the family's motion) + 960 mm (arm) + 150 mm slack; arm hemisphere test R=700 mm above the base plane
